ruleDefinitions.name: Gpscript Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of the LOLBIN gpscript, which executes logon or startup scripts configured in Group Policy

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\gpscript\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "GPSCRIPT\.EXE") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/logon.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/startup.*"))) AND  NOT (parent_process_command_line = "C\:\\windows\\system32\\svchost\.exe\ \-k\ netsvcs\ \-p\ \-s\ gpsvc")
